name: Delete user account
description: Erase a venue account, profile, login aliases and namespace; cancel its jobs, agents and schedules. Requires venue-issued user/delete authority on <venueDID>/users, even for the caller's own account. Retains a minimal account tombstone and public key revocations. Recreation follows the existing venue admission policy and starts with an empty account. Physical erasure requires collecting unreferenced data and expiring retained checkpoints/backups.

did.description: Exact DID of the account to delete
